sourceText:
Baby Spinach and Burrata Cheese Pasta
By: Maike Corbett
Published: Sunday, June 9, 2019 - 6:12pm

Ingredients




Fusilli Pasta
Butter
Olive Oil
Fresh Garlic Cloves
Lemon Juice
Baby Spinach
Burrata Cheese

Preparation

1 Cook pasta. Sauté garlic, and baby spinach. 2 Step-by-step instructions on blog.

About

This simple 15-minute burrata cheese pasta recipe is perfect for weeknight dinners. Baby spinach, garlic, and lemon juice balance each other perfectly. Adding the rich, creamy Burrata cheese makes this dish extra special.
